definitions.explanation: A hollow space or opening in something. Can be natural or man-made.
A missing part or position that needs to be filled.

examples.japanese: {穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}いている→開く：00689_aku⟧。

examples.english: There's a hole in the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}りました→掘る：00442_horu⟧。
examples.english: I dug a big hole in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧。
⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A gap opened up in my schedule.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞|や}めたら→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧。
examples.english: If he quits, it will leave a big gap.
examples.notes: Figurative: a vacancy that is hard to fill

notes:
{穴|あな} means hole or opening, used for both physical holes and figurative gaps or deficits.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}く→開く：00689_aku⟧: a hole opens/forms
- {穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to make a hole
- {穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧: to dig a hole
- {穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧: to fill a hole/gap

USAGE:
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{穴|あな}: budget gap/deficit
- ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{穴|あな}: gap in a schedule
- {穴|あな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧: to make up for a loss or vacancy

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {穴|あな}⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧: hidden gem, little-known spot
- {穴|あな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{入|はい}りたい→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to want to crawl into a hole (from embarrassment)
- ⟦{大穴|おおあな}→大穴：noentry⟧: long-shot winner (horse racing/betting); also a large hole
